ul.li: DeviceDefinition.hasPart represents the component definitions that are part of this kind of device. This direction supports reusable component definitions and lets the parent definition state how many components of that kind are expected. For example, a vital signs monitor definition can list blood pressure, oximeter, and temperature module definitions as component parts.

Device represents a particular device instance, so its hierarchy uses Device.parent from a component to the single higher-level device of which it is currently a part. For example, the actual blood pressure, oximeter, and temperature modules plugged into a monitor each point to that monitor as their parent. Both representations can be traversed in either direction through search include and revInclude, but each resource uses the direction that fits its expected use.
